message.guildmark.cook.private: This one is kept for whoever set it down, and their party.
message.guildmark.cook.guest_no: The innkeeper shakes her head: the back pot is for those she knows.
message.guildmark.cook.nothing_to_burn: There's nothing in the fire to light.
message.guildmark.cook.fuel_too_much: That's too much for the fire.
message.guildmark.cook.fuel_full: The fire can't hold any more.
message.guildmark.cook.fuel: The fire is fed: %s of fuel.
message.guildmark.cook.fire_lit: The fire burns: %s of fuel left.
message.guildmark.cook.fire_cold: The fire is out. It has %s of fuel.
message.guildmark.cook.call.stick: The pot is catching: stir it with a ladle.
message.guildmark.cook.call.stick.pan: The pan is catching: scrape it with the turner.
message.guildmark.cook.call.boil_over: It's about to boil over: ease the heat.
message.guildmark.cook.call.skim: Scum is rising: skim it with a ladle.
message.guildmark.cook.call.flare: The fat has caught: ease the heat.
message.guildmark.cook.call.turn: One side is browning: turn it with the turner.
message.guildmark.cook.call.turn.spit: One side is browning: turn the crank.
message.guildmark.cook.call.season: It wants a touch of something: a herb, honey, an egg, milk or a mushroom.
message.guildmark.cook.missed.flare: The fat flared and scorched it.
message.guildmark.cook.missed.season: The moment for seasoning has passed.
